# requirements.txt for Rafawa Desktop
# Generated by scanning every actual import across the real project source,
# not from memory - this is what's genuinely used, nothing more.

# GUI framework
PySide2>=5.15,<6

# Database ORM
SQLAlchemy>=2.0,<3

# SQLAlchemy needs greenlet. Newer greenlet releases have no prebuilt Windows wheel for Python 3.9, so pip would try
# to compile it (needs Microsoft C++ Build Tools). 3.2.x has wheels for 3.9 and 3.10.
greenlet>=3.0,<3.3

# MySQL driver - never imported directly by name anywhere in the project,
# but required: database/engine.py builds a "mysql+pymysql://" connection
# string, and SQLAlchemy loads this driver dynamically based on that.
PyMySQL>=1.1,<2

# Schema migrations (mentioned as the next setup step - included so it's
# ready when you get to it, even though it isn't actively used yet)
alembic>=1.13,<2

# HTTP client - used in shared/api/client.py and the supplier-related
# integration code
httpx>=0.27,<1

# Windows thermal/receipt printing (win32print) - Windows-only, so this
# line is skipped automatically if requirements.txt is ever installed on
# a non-Windows machine
pywin32>=306; platform_system == "Windows"

# Excel export - used by the Customer Profile Activity tab's "Export to
# Excel" button
openpyxl>=3.1,<4
